title: Findings
description: One live verification pass over a feature map: the pass's build, each driven or skipped entry, and one record per finding id. scripts/findings-compare.sh reads two of these files and labels each finding id NEW, PRE-EXISTING, GONE or not checked.

build.description: The build the pass drove, such as a commit SHA or a release tag. A comparison report shows both passes' builds in its header.

entries.description: One row per entry the pass listed, driven or not. A finding only shows as GONE when every entry point it listed in the earlier pass was driven here.

findings.description: One record per finding id. Two records with the same id are invalid, so a failure seen through several entry points is a single record that lists each one.

Part.description: The feature's part (the <part> of <feature>/<part>), or null when the pass drove whole features.

feature.description: The feature id, its index path without features/ and the trailing /README.md.

entry_point.description: The entry point's text, as the feature file lists it.

outcome.description: passed or failed when the entry was driven. not checked when it was blocked, not driven or left out by a cap; such an entry is never a finding.

reason.description: Why the entry was not checked, such as cap or the blocked: line. Null when it was driven.

wall_time_seconds.description: Measured wall time for the entry. Null when not measured, never an estimate.

tokens.description: Measured tokens the entry spent. Null when not measured, never an estimate.

unmeasured_reason.description: Why wall_time_seconds or tokens is null. Null when both were measured.

id.description: A short hex hash of feature, part, kind and where, without the entry point, so it stays the same across passes. Passes are matched by exact id.

kind.description: result-not-met for a stated result or proof end state the run did not reach. The other five are the closed list of breakage kinds for a defect the map states nothing about.

where.description: The drive step number, proof for the proof step, or run for the run as a whole.

entry_points.description: Every entry point the finding showed at.

label.description: stated when the finding fails a result the feature file states, unstated for breakage the map states nothing about.

evidence.description: Evidence paths, relative to the pass's run directory.
